acceptance: An acceptance item starting 'observed(<role>[, <tier>]):' (schema description and docs) can only be satisfied by a recorded observation on the planning sheet ('A#: observed by <name> as <role> on <tier>, <date>: <result>'), as human: items need a decision; finish-this-task refuses while one lacks it; reviewers mark it n/a with reason 'observed', and an executor's READY or summary cannot satisfy it

review-packet (through review_packet_observed.py; review_packet.py is at its 400-line cap) flags executor text (summary or READY) that claims a role, stage, server or walkthrough observation for an observed( item, quoting the line and saying it is executor-supplied; a test with the reported shape (timings measured inside pytest presented as a role-observed table) asserts the flag

The reviewer prompt separates coordinator-supplied probes (a 'Coordinator probes' section: run them and report; a failure is a finding, not an acceptance failure unless an acceptance item covers it) from acceptance items; a test asserts the section heading and wording. Out of scope: verifying who made an observation
nodes.title: Role-observed acceptance needs evidence from that role, and coordinator probes are not acceptance
